In a story told by [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Parent/Legends|mothers]], the '''Rha clan''' was a Twi'lek group. They were rivals with the [[Lek clan]]. [[Oo'rha]] was a notable individual who belonged to the Rha clan.
